note: Invented: Victor asking a vendor (Orbis Worldwide) for a CY to door rate. 'Please quote below' is us asking, not us giving a rate; the lane is read from the Origin / Dest lines.
subject: RATE REQUEST // MEMPHIS CY - SANTO DOMINGO DOOR // NON-STACKABLE SKIDS

Victor Lang
